initial_prompt: Explain the concept of entropy to a 5-year-old.

messages.content: Explain the concept of entropy to a 5-year-old.

Imagine a sandcastle.

Building it takes work to make the sand stay in a special shape. But if you leave it alone, the wind and water will knock it down and spread the sand everywhere.

**Entropy** is the rule that says things naturally want to fall apart and get messy, rather than stay neat and tidy. It is why your room gets messy easily, but takes hard work to clean up.
